name: GitDash
description: Snapshots your level on every save so you can roll back to any previous state from the editor pause menu.

max-snapshots.name: Max Snapshots Per Level
max-snapshots.description: Maximum number of snapshots to keep per level. Oldest are deleted when limit is reached.

snapshot-on-autosave.name: Snapshot on Autosave
snapshot-on-autosave.description: Also create a snapshot whenever autosave triggers.

show-timestamps.name: Show Timestamps in Timeline
show-timestamps.description: Show HH:MM:SS timestamps on each snapshot.
